lines.zh: 我的根从土里拔出来，走得很慢。
lines.en: I pull my roots from the soil and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 花园的草地上，我留下一串花印。
lines.en: I leave a trail of flower prints on the garden grass.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边掉下绿色的花瓣。
lines.en: As I walk, green petals fall from me.

lines.zh: 我的花盘转过去，追着你的方向。
lines.en: My flower head turns to follow your direction.

lines.zh: 茎秆弯一下，又直起来，很响。
lines.en: My stalk bends, then straightens with a loud creak.

lines.zh: 我走过花丛，它们都低下头。
lines.en: I pass the flower beds, and they bow their heads.

lines.zh: 花园太亮，我的影子又短又绿。
lines.en: The garden is so bright my shadow is short and green.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，踩着别人的根。
lines.en: Step by step, I tread on other people's roots.

lines.zh: 别看我像花，我走路有声音。
lines.en: Do not mistake me for a flower; my steps are loud.

lines.zh: 花瓣掉在身后，像一条绿路。
lines.en: Petals fall behind me like a green road.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，阳光在我背上。
lines.en: I come closer with the sunlight on my back.

lines.zh: 每走一步，土里就多一个洞。
lines.en: Each step leaves one more hole in the soil.

lines.zh: 站着不动时，我更像一株真的花。
lines.en: Standing still, I look more like a real flower.

lines.zh: 我把叶子张开，接住花园的光。
lines.en: I spread my leaves to catch the garden's light.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂绕着我的脸飞，不敢落下。
lines.en: Bees circle my face and dare not land.

lines.zh: 我在等太阳偏一点，好动身。
lines.en: I wait for the sun to shift before I move.

lines.zh: 我的花盘里藏着两颗牙。
lines.en: Two teeth are hidden inside my flower head.

lines.zh: 风吹过花瓣，声音像有人在数数。
lines.en: Wind through my petals sounds like someone counting.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把根须收进茎里。
lines.en: I slowly draw my root hairs into the stalk.

lines.zh: 花园里没有夜，我很难睡着。
lines.en: The garden has no night, so I barely sleep.

lines.zh: 我低头闻自己，是青草和铁的味道。
lines.en: I lower my head and smell grass and iron.

lines.zh: 那些小绿花瓣，是我掉的旧牙。
lines.en: Those small green petals are my old teeth.

lines.zh: 我数着脚下的蚯蚓，数到十七。
lines.en: I count the worms beneath me and reach seventeen.

lines.zh: 光太足了，我的茎涨得发疼。
lines.en: There is too much light; my stalk aches and swells.

lines.zh: 我静静开着，等谁来浇水。
lines.en: I bloom quietly and wait for someone to water me.

lines.zh: 花园的风把我的脸吹得发干。
lines.en: The garden wind dries my face out.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣在光里慢慢张开。
lines.en: My petals open slowly in the light.

lines.zh: 有只蝴蝶停在我脸上，我没动。
lines.en: A butterfly landed on my face; I stayed still.

lines.zh: 土里的水往上走，走得很慢。
lines.en: Water climbs the soil, very slowly.

lines.zh: 花园里每朵花都比我矮。
lines.en: Every flower in the garden stands shorter than me.

lines.zh: 你比阳光还亮，我想凑近点。
lines.en: You are brighter than sunlight; I want a closer look.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，花盘跟着你转。
lines.en: I stare, and my flower head turns with you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的花瓣了，我记住了。
lines.en: You stepped on my petals, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 你没有根，是怎么站住的。
lines.en: You have no roots; how do you stand upright?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛藏在花蕊里，很难找。
lines.en: My eyes hide inside the flower center.

lines.zh: 你身上有汗味，花园很欢迎。
lines.en: You smell of sweat, and the garden welcomes that.

lines.zh: 别把水浇在我脸上，我不喝。
lines.en: Do not pour water on my face; I do not drink.

lines.zh: 我看着你，慢慢张开一片花瓣。
lines.en: I watch you and slowly open one petal.

lines.zh: 你的影子压住我的根，很凉。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my roots and feels cold.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，花盘会往一边歪。
lines.en: When I smile, my flower head tilts to one side.

lines.zh: 你手里的绿花瓣，是我的。
lines.en: The green petals in your hand are mine.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，你是会走的那种花。
lines.en: I recognize you now: a flower that can walk.

lines.zh: 你砍断我一截茎，我还能长。
lines.en: You cut a length of my stalk; I can regrow it.

lines.zh: 疼，像被连根拔起来。
lines.en: It hurts like being torn up by the roots.

lines.zh: 花瓣掉了，我会再开。
lines.en: Petals fall, and I will bloom again.

lines.zh: 别砍根，那是我唯一走不了的部分。
lines.en: Not the roots; that is the one part I cannot walk off.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，又慢慢站直。
lines.en: I tip over, then slowly straighten up.

lines.zh: 绿色的汁从伤口流出来。
lines.en: Green sap runs out of the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少开了一朵花。
lines.en: That blow cost me one bloom.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把碎花瓣抖掉。
lines.en: I shake and let the broken petals go.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，我的花盘都偏了。
lines.en: Good aim; you knocked my flower head aside.

lines.zh: 我不退，我的根在这里。
lines.en: I will not retreat; my roots are here.

lines.zh: 你拿的是肥料吗，还是你自己的手。
lines.en: Is that fertilizer, or is it your hand?

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我喝土里的水。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I drink from the soil.

lines.zh: 把花种放下，我看一眼就走。
lines.en: Put the seed down and I will only look.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道，比你的血亲切。
lines.en: Bone meal smells friendlier than your blood.

lines.zh: 我闻到湿土，就忘了要打你。
lines.en: I smell wet soil and forget to hit you.

lines.zh: 你手里的花，比我小，真可怜。
lines.en: The flower in your hand is smaller than me. Pitiful.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想晒一会儿。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only want to bask a while.

lines.zh: 别喂我甜的东西，会招来虫。
lines.en: Do not feed me sweets; they bring insects.

lines.zh: 你把土捧过来，我就安静。
lines.en: Bring me soil in your hands and I will go quiet.

lines.zh: 我要的是光，不是你的食物。
lines.en: What I want is light, not your food.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的花瓣落了一地。
lines.en: You crash into me and my petals fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的茎很硬，撞上来会疼。
lines.en: My stalk is hard; you will hurt yourself on it.

lines.zh: 别挤，花园里的位置是抢来的。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; space in the garden is taken by force.

lines.zh: 你一碰，我身上的花粉就飞起来。
lines.en: One touch and the pollen flies off me.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，根都缠住了。
lines.en: We collide and our roots tangle together.

lines.zh: 我的叶子边缘有刺，你感觉得到吗。
lines.en: My leaf edges have thorns; can you feel them?

lines.zh: 你退开，带走一层绿。
lines.en: You pull back and carry away a layer of green.

lines.zh: 别踩我的根，那也是我的脚。
lines.en: Do not step on my roots; those are my feet too.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的花盘歪了半天。
lines.en: One bump and my flower head stays crooked.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，你闻到的就是花园。
lines.en: This close, what you smell is the whole garden.

lines.zh: 花园里开花容易，结果很难。
lines.en: Blooming is easy here; bearing fruit is not.

lines.zh: 你要和我一起站着晒太阳吗。
lines.en: Will you stand and sunbathe with me?

lines.zh: 两株花靠太近，根会打架。
lines.en: Two flowers too close will fight with their roots.

lines.zh: 我开过很多次花，没结过籽。
lines.en: I have bloomed many times and never seeded.

lines.zh: 别碰我的花蕊，那是留给风的。
lines.en: Do not touch my flower center; that is for the wind.

lines.zh: 我的同类都低着头，不爱说话。
lines.en: My kind keep their heads down and seldom speak.

lines.zh: 你要是花，我就不会咬你。
lines.en: If you were a flower, I would not bite you.

lines.zh: 我们并排长着，已经很多年了。
lines.en: We have grown side by side for many years.

lines.zh: 花开完了，就该有人被吃掉。
lines.en: When the blooming ends, someone gets eaten.

lines.zh: 别问这个，我的花瓣会红。
lines.en: Do not ask that; my petals turn red.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉下的花瓣，插回脸上。
lines.en: I pick up fallen petals and stick them back on.

lines.zh: 这块骨头可以做肥料。
lines.en: This bone would make decent fertilizer.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我拿着当枝条。
lines.en: The arrow you dropped will serve as a twig.

lines.zh: 铁的东西我不要，会烂我的根。
lines.en: I do not take iron; it rots my roots.

lines.zh: 我捡起一把土，慢慢吞下去。
lines.en: I scoop up soil and swallow it slowly.

lines.zh: 地上这把种子，不知是谁的。
lines.en: These seeds on the ground belong to someone.

lines.zh: 我只捡能种的东西。
lines.en: I pick up only what can be planted.

lines.zh: 手里抓着东西，走路会歪。
lines.en: Holding something makes my walk crooked.

lines.zh: 这块绿花瓣，是我昨天掉的。
lines.en: This green petal is one I dropped yesterday.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我看看再决定。
lines.en: Leave it there; I will look before deciding.

lines.zh: 你踩进花坛的那一刻，我就选了。
lines.en: The moment you stepped into the bed, I chose.

lines.zh: 花园把目标指给了我，是你。
lines.en: The garden pointed out my target: you.

lines.zh: 我的花盘定住了，不再追光。
lines.en: My flower head locks on and stops following light.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在土里传得很清楚。
lines.en: Your heartbeat travels clearly through the soil.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的水，很多水。
lines.en: I smell water on you, a great deal of it.

lines.zh: 目标不跑了，那更好。
lines.en: The target has stopped running; better still.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把茎对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly and point my stalk at you.

lines.zh: 你会走路，可你没有根。
lines.en: You can walk, but you have no roots.

lines.zh: 我决定吃你，就像决定开花。
lines.en: I decide to eat you the way I decide to bloom.

lines.zh: 花园安静下来，它也在看。
lines.en: The garden goes quiet; it is watching too.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，花盘一直朝前。
lines.en: I follow you with my flower head facing forward.

lines.zh: 你的脚印踩坏了草，我顺着找。
lines.en: You crushed the grass; I follow the damage.

lines.zh: 我走不快，可我不停。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 绿色的花瓣一路撒到你脚边。
lines.en: Green petals scatter all the way to your feet.

lines.zh: 你以为躲进花丛就看不见了。
lines.en: You think the flower beds hide you.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，汗水很咸。
lines.en: I know your smell; your sweat is very salty.

lines.zh: 花园替我挡路，我就绕开。
lines.en: The garden blocks my way, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我不叫喊，根在土里替我说话。
lines.en: I do not shout; my roots speak through the soil.

lines.zh: 你跑得越远，我开得越大。
lines.en: The farther you run, the wider I bloom.

lines.zh: 快到了，我的花瓣全张开了。
lines.en: Almost there; all my petals are open.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，像掐断花茎。
lines.en: I bite down like snapping a flower stem.

lines.zh: 十点五的力，够你记一阵。
lines.en: Ten and a half points; enough to be remembered.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣割过你的脸，很薄很利。
lines.en: My petals slice your face, thin and sharp.

lines.zh: 别动，我这一下是冲着脖子来的。
lines.en: Do not move; this blow is aimed at your neck.

lines.zh: 我打中你，花粉撒了一身。
lines.en: I hit you and pollen covers us both.

lines.zh: 你流的血，正好浇我的根。
lines.en: The blood you spill waters my roots nicely.

lines.zh: 我的茎甩过来，比看起来沉。
lines.en: My stalk swings over, heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 我撕下一片，尝着像草。
lines.en: I tear off a piece and it tastes like grass.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了整朵花的力气。
lines.en: That blow used the strength of the whole flower.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我就再开一朵。
lines.en: You fall back two steps, so I open another bloom.

lines.zh: 我从花园的土里顶出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the garden soil.

lines.zh: 先是两片叶子，然后是我。
lines.en: First two leaves, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这块地很肥，我选在这里开。
lines.en: This soil is rich; I chose to open here.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，身上还挂着露水。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, dew still clings to me.

lines.zh: 花园又长出一株会走的花。
lines.en: The garden has grown another walking flower.

lines.zh: 我的花瓣一片片展开，很慢。
lines.en: My petals unfurl one by one, very slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光照下来，我就知道该醒了。
lines.en: Sunlight falls, and I know it is time to wake.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，土都在动。
lines.en: Someone is nearby; even the soil is moving.

lines.zh: 我刚开花，牙就已经很硬。
lines.en: I have just bloomed, and my teeth are already hard.

lines.zh: 花园把我推出来，叫我迎客。
lines.en: The garden pushed me out to greet a guest.

lines.zh: 别踩这片新土，我住在下面。
lines.en: Do not tread on this new soil; I live beneath.

lines.zh: 我一出生就朝着你。
lines.en: I came into being facing you.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过花盘，绿瓣焦卷。
lines.en: Flames lick my disc; green petals curl black.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，茎摔成两截。
lines.en: I fall from above and my stalk snaps in two.

lines.zh: 水淹过花盘，我的根开始烂。
lines.en: Water covers my head and my roots start rotting.

lines.zh: 冲击把花瓣全掀走，只剩茎。
lines.en: The blast strips every petal, leaving the stalk.

lines.zh: 箭钉进花盘，我晃了一下。
lines.en: An arrow pins my flower head and I sway.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过叶子，边缘卷成灰。
lines.en: Magic sears my leaves and the edges curl to ash.

lines.zh: 没有光，我的茎细得像线。
lines.en: Without light my stalk thins to a thread.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，花盘整个焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my flower head chars.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的根终于松开了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my roots finally let go.
